data.long_meaning: The name Onyinye is of Igbo origin and translates to 'Onyi' meaning 'God' and 'Nye' meaning 'Gift'. This name is a beautiful testament to the belief that every child is a precious gift from God. The name Onyinye carries the meaning “Gift of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Igbo. Parents who choose Onyinye usually hope their child will grow to embody gift of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
